rejected_rule.statement: The court ruled that the will did not create a valid fidei commissum.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I can only say that it is a very confused document, and it is difficult to say what was in the mind of the notary who drew it up. ... The gift or disposition therefore in favour of the Crown, in case of alienation, appears to my mind to militate against the view that a fidei commissum was intended"

meta.parties: Fernando Et Al v. Salgodo Et Al
